prompts.prompt: What brought you a silent moment of calm today?
Name one sensation (a breeze, a sound, a taste) that grounded you.
What meaningful progress did you make today, however modest?
What is one challenge you navigated with patience?
How did your body feel throughout the morning and evening?
What nourishment or movement restored your energy today?
What small ritual anchored your morning or wind-down routine?
What is one thing you are looking forward to tomorrow?
